verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents an Admin API that can create and update flags, with anything doable in the dashboard also doable via the API. It also ships an official CLI and an official MCP server for AI agents, plus Change Requests (create, approve, publish four-eyes workflow), RBAC to restrict who can modify production, and Release Pipelines that auto-generate change requests when promoting to production. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that change requests are enforced on API/MCP/CLI writes so an agent's token cannot bypass approval, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the agent-plus-approval flow.
